## "date_audited"

**Data type:**  
String  

**Value:**  
Timestamp of the type: ISO 8601:YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ or null.

**Description of metadata field:**  
This is the last date the asset was audited. Auditing happens following complete processing of the asset following digitisation.

**Populated by whom and when:**  
ARS when an asset is has its audit status set to "true".

**Updated where and when:**  
In ARS when a user audits an asset that had previously been audited.

**Generated by:**  
ARS

**Maps to in ARS:**  
date_audited

**Maps to in Specify:**  
None

**Notes and issues:**  
None
